text: Confidential Information means any non-public technical, financial or business information disclosed by one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or by inspection of tangible objects.
The Receiving Party shall hold the Discloser's Confidential Information in strict confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.

The Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to its employees and professional advisers who need to know it, provided each such person is bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as those in this Agreement.
Confidential Information does not include information that is or becomes publicly available through no breach of this Agreement, or that was lawfully known to the Receiving Party before disclosure.
Upon written request, the Receiving Party shall promptly return or destroy all materials containing Confidential Information and certify such destruction in writing.
This Agreement remains in effect for three years from the Effective Date, and the confidentiality obligations survive termination for a further two years.
The parties agree that any breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be inadequate, and the disclosing party is entitled to seek injunctive relief.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
Services means the professional services described in a mutually executed statement of work.
The Supplier shall perform the Services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with the applicable statement of work.
Either party may request a change to the Services by written change order, and no change is binding until both parties sign it.
The Supplier shall submit invoices monthly in arrears, and the Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty days of receipt.
Overdue amounts accrue interest at one percent per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is lower.
This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and renews automatically for successive twelve-month terms unless either party gives sixty days' written notice of non-renewal.
The Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience on ninety days' written notice, subject to payment for Services performed before the effective date of termination.
Except for fraud and wilful misconduct, neither party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim.
The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer against third-party claims that the Services infringe a patent, copyright or trade secret, provided the Customer promptly notifies the Supplier.
Neither party may assign this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, except to an affiliate or in connection with a merger.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of London.
Subject to payment of the applicable fees, the Provider grants the Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access and use the hosted service during the subscription term.
The Provider shall make the hosted service available at least 99.9 percent of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance windows notified in advance.
Subscription fees are billed annually in advance and are non-refundable except as expressly stated in this Agreement.
As between the parties, the Customer owns all Customer Data, and the Provider processes Customer Data only to provide the hosted service.
The Customer shall not use the hosted service to store or transmit unlawful content or attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the service.
The Provider may suspend the hosted service immediately if continued use poses a security risk and may terminate this Agreement for material breach not cured within thirty days of notice.
The Provider warrants that the hosted service will perform materially in accordance with the documentation, and the Customer's exclusive remedy is repair or replacement.
The parties shall comply with applicable data protection law, and the Provider shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of California.
Personal Data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person that the Processor processes on behalf of the Controller.
The Controller is the data controller and the Processor processes Personal Data only as a data processor.
The Processor shall process Personal Data only on documented instructions from the Controller, unless required to do so by law.
The Processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, including encryption of data in transit and at rest, to protect Personal Data.
The Processor shall not engage any subprocessor without the Controller's prior written authorisation and shall impose equivalent data protection obligations on each subprocessor.
The Processor shall assist the Controller in responding to data subject requests to access, rectify or erase Personal Data within the timeframes required by law.
The Processor shall not transfer Personal Data outside the European Economic Area unless the transfer is covered by an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards.
On termination, the Processor shall delete or return all Personal Data at the Controller's choice and delete existing copies unless storage is required by law.
Each party's liability under this Addendum is subject to the limitations set out in the main agreement.
The Company appoints the Reseller as a non-exclusive reseller of the Products in the Territory.
The Reseller shall use commercially reasonable efforts to promote and sell the Products and shall not make any representation or warranty on the Company's behalf.
The Company shall sell the Products to the Reseller at the discount set out in Schedule 1, and the Reseller may set its own resale prices.
All orders placed by the Reseller are subject to acceptance by the Company, and no order is binding until the Company issues a written order confirmation.

The Reseller acknowledges that all intellectual property rights in the Products remain vested in the Company and shall not modify, reverse engineer or remove any proprietary notices from the Products.
The Company grants the Reseller a non-exclusive, revocable licence to use the Company's trademarks solely to market the Products during the term.
This Agreement continues for one year and may be terminated by either party on sixty days' written notice, or immediately for material breach that remains uncured for fifteen days.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County.
The Supplier shall provide the consulting services described in this Statement of Work under and subject to the terms of the Master Services Agreement.
The Supplier shall deliver a technical design document, a working prototype and a final implementation report.
The project comprises three milestones, each completed on the dates set out in the project schedule.
The Customer shall pay the Supplier a fixed fee of one hundred thousand dollars for the Deliverables.
The Customer shall reimburse reasonable pre-approved travel expenses supported by receipts.
The Customer shall review each Deliverable within ten business days and either accept it or provide written notice of deficiencies.
A steering committee comprising one representative of each party shall meet fortnightly to review progress.
The Customer shall provide timely access to subject-matter experts and test environments.
The Supplier's delivery obligations are subject to the Customer's performance of its dependencies.
Any change to the scope, schedule or fees requires a written change order signed by both parties.
Software means the object code version of the vendor's application made available to the Licensee under this Agreement.
Subject to payment of the licence fee, the Vendor grants the Licensee a perpetual, non-exclusive licence to install and use the Software for its internal business purposes.
The Licensee shall not sublicense, rent, lease or distribute the Software, nor use it to provide services to third parties, without the Vendor's prior written consent.
The Licensee shall pay the licence fee within thirty days of the invoice date, and all fees are non-refundable.
The Vendor shall provide email support during business hours and shall supply bug fixes and minor updates at no additional charge.
Major new releases are licensed separately, and this Agreement does not entitle the Licensee to any major new release.
Except as expressly stated, the Software is provided as is without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied.
The Vendor's total liability shall not exceed the licence fees paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.
The Vendor may terminate this Agreement immediately if the Licensee materially breaches it and fails to cure within thirty days of written notice.
Notices must be written and delivered by hand, courier or registered post to the addresses stated in the order form.
